attributes.name: Muck Graul
attributes.powers:
Muck Graul is immune to the Acid trait.

Add 1 die to checks to defeat Muck with the Fire trait.

If the check to defeat does not have the Fire trait, Muck is undefeated.

If undefeated, choose a random character at this location to encounter Muck; after that encounter, put Muck on the bottom of the location deck.

corrections.corrected_text: On the monster Muck Graul, change his last power to the following:"If undefeated, choose a random character at this location to encounter Muck; after that encounter, put Muck on the bottom of the location deck."
corrections.issue: I don't understand what happens when you fail to defeat Muck Graul. Does he keep passing around until somebody beats him?
